dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-selkies:ubunturesolute

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG BAMBUSTUDIO_VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="thelamer"

# title
ENV TITLE=BambuStudio \
    SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt \
    NO_GAMEPAD=true \
    PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=true

RUN \
  echo "**** add icon ****" && \
  curl -o \
    /usr/share/selkies/www/icon.png \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linuxserver/docker-templates/master/linuxserver.io/img/bambustudio-logo.png && \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  add-apt-repository ppa:xtradeb/apps && \
  apt-get update && \
  DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive \
  apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y \
    firefox \
    fonts-dejavu \
    fonts-dejavu-extra \
    gir1.2-gst-plugins-bad-1.0 \
    gir1.2-gstreamer-1.0 \
    gstreamer1.0-nice \
    gstreamer1.0-plugins-* \
    gstreamer1.0-pulseaudio \
    libosmesa6 \
    libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0 \
    libwx-perl && \
  echo "**** install bambu studio from appimage ****" && \
  if [ -z ${BAMBUSTUDIO_VERSION+x} ]; then \
    BAMBUSTUDIO_VERSION=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/bambulab/BambuStudio/releases" \
      | jq -r '.[0].tag_name'); \
  fi && \
  RELEASE_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/bambulab/BambuStudio/releases/tags/${BAMBUSTUDIO_VERSION}" && \
  DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -sX GET "${RELEASE_URL}" \
    | jq -r 'first(.assets[].browser_download_url | select(test("BambuStudio_ubu24")))') && \
  cd /tmp && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/bambu.app -L \
    "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" && \
  chmod +x /tmp/bambu.app && \
  ./bambu.app --appimage-extract && \
  mv squashfs-root /opt/bambustudio && \
  ln -s \
    /opt/bambustudio/resources/fonts \
    /usr/share/fonts/bambustudio && \
  fc-cache -f && \
  localedef -i en_GB -f UTF-8 en_GB.UTF-8 && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apt-get autoclean && \
  rm -rf \
    /config/.cache \
    /config/.launchpadlib \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/tmp/* \
    /tmp/*

# add local files
COPY /root /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 3001
VOLUME /config

notes.upstream:
> 🌐 [English](#english) | [中文](#中文) ## English This Bambu Studio release adds support for the Bambu Lab H3C, the new multi-nozzle printer in the Bambu Lab H series. It also brings a range of major features and improvements, along with fixes for a number of stability and security issues. You can download the Flathub version for Linux from [Bambu Studio on Flathub](https://flathub.org/en/apps/com.bambulab.BambuStudio) The Flathub version is maintained by [@hadess](https://github.com/hadess) ; thanks to him for his outstanding work. ### New Features #### Mixed Nozzle Diameter Slicing and Printing This is the most important update in this Bambu Studio release. Printing with multiple nozzle diameters is not a new topic. Previously, users could assign filament and nozzles by slicing line type such as wall, infill, and support, for example, by setting the filament for sparse infill, solid infill, and walls on the Process > Strength > Advanced page. What is different about this update is that Bambu Studio extends this capability into regions of the model: within a single model, users can assign nozzles of different diameters to local details and to the main body, **and let each nozzle print at its own appropriate layer height.** This means that, even within the same height range of a model, **a small nozzle no longer has to increase its layer height to accommodate the main body, and a large nozzle no longer has to keep using thin layers for local details**. A small nozzle can reproduce text and scales with a narrower line width and thinner layers; a large nozzle prints the main body with a wider line width and thicker layers. Detail is left to the areas that need it, and efficiency is left to the areas suited to fast printing. Thanks to this capability, with the Maker Watch (by DadaLand) printed on the Bambu Lab H3C, the fine watch face, the watch case body, and the flexible TPU strap can be completed in a single print job, reducing the need for separate parts and post-print assembly. See [the Wiki](https://e.bambulab.com/t?c=Sqg2600TPZCRDDpU) to learn how the feature works, when it applies, and its limitations. This capability was made possible by extensive refactoring of the slicing architecture, so all multi-nozzle models benefit. Mixed nozzle diameters involve multiple workstreams, including slicing, materials, presets, and AMS and nozzle-switching compatibility. This release supports the Bambu Lab H3C first. Information about support for other models will be provided in official announcements. We thank users for their patience, and we welcome feedback from users and the community on slicing and printing results with real models, as well as updates and iterations based on the Bambu Studio open-source code. #### Color Mixing Updates and Improvements - Consolidated workflow: Color Split has been merged into the mixed-color page and renamed Color Matching. When adding a mixed-color filament, Manual Mixing and Color Matching are both available on the same page. Color Matching lets you pick a target color from the project filaments, automatically calculates a matching mixed-color result, and lets you adjust that result. - Easier to use: for the Bambu Lab H3C 0.4 mm nozzle presets at 0.2 mm and 0.24 mm layer heights, the color mixing sublayer feature is enabled by default, with no manual setup required. - More flexible filament setup: mixed-color filaments no longer count toward the project limit of 32 filaments, and support has been added for **Bambu PLA Palette**, Bambu Lab's color mixing kit. Click "Use Official Color Mixing Kit" to automatically add the filaments in the kit. - Less repetitive setup: when adding a mixed-color filament manually, the previous color mixing parameters are reused, making duplication and fine-tuning easier. - Smoother texture model import: the import page is now a two-step flow with clearer guidance; color quantization performance has been improved; Bambu color mixing kits can now be bound directly; and the UI and visual layout have been refined. > In addition, this release includes the features from the [2.8.3](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/releases#release-v02.08.03.66) and [2.8.4](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/releases#release-v02.08.04.57) Public Beta releases. > > #### Optimized Top Surface Monotonic Line Infill Path to Reduce Travel Moves > > This version optimizes the printing path for the top surface monotonic line infill pattern, reducing travel moves during printing and improving print efficiency. > > The improvement is more noticeable on models with more detailed and complex top surfaces. > > > > > > >
> > #### Illustrated Slicing Parameter Tips > > When users hover the mouse over a process parameter name, Bambu Studio will display the corresponding parameter tip. Parameter tips now support illustrated explanations, making it easier to understand what each setting means, how it works, and how it may affect the print result. This helps new users learn and adjust slicing parameters more easily. > > > > Note: This update mainly covers process parameters in Simple Mode. Tips for more advanced parameters will be added and improved in future releases. > > #### Independently Set Initial Layer Wall and Infill Line Widths > > This version adds a new **Initial Layer Infill** **Line Width** parameter. The original **Initial** **Layer Line Width** parameter now only applies to lines except the infill lines on the initial layer, including the initial-layer wall lines, allowing users to control the wall line width and infill line width of the initial layer separately. > > Users can moderately increase the initial-layer infill line width based on actual print results. For example, when using a 0.4 mm nozzle, setting the initial-layer infill line width to 0.55 mm can help improve initial-layer adhesion and reduce the chance of poor initial-layer printing. > > > > Note: It is not recommended to set the initial-layer wall line width too large, as this may increase the risk of losing fine details on the initial layer for certain models. > > #### Add Filament Vendors / Brands from the Filament Manager Entry Page > > This version improves the filament entry workflow in the Filament Manager. Users can now add custom filament vendors or brands directly from the entry page. > > > > When the corresponding filament parameter preset does not exist, users can create a custom filament directly in the Filament Manager without switching to the Prepare page, making the workflow more convenient and efficient. > > > > #### New Archimedean Spiral Pattern for Ironing, Providing a More Uniform Surface Finish > > This version adds a new Archimedean spiral pattern for ironing. The new pattern expands outward gradually from the center of the region, and the toolpath can be naturally interrupted by internal holes in the model. Compared with the standard concentric pattern, it helps reduce marks caused by the innermost toolpaths and produces a more uniform ironing result. > > > Note: Ironing quality is affected by multiple factors, including flow rate, line spacing, top surface print speed, temperature, and the physical properties of the material. Users should tune the settings based on actual print results. The default parameters may not be suitable for all scenarios. (See [Wiki](https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/software/bambu-studio/parameter/ironing) for more info) > > #### New Infill Pattern Parameter for the Sub-Top Surface > > This version separates the sub-top surface from internal solid infill, allowing users to set its infill pattern independently. > > > > By default, the sub-top surface now uses monotonic infill instead of the rectilinear pattern previously used for internal solid infill. This helps reduce the visibility of extrusion marks from internal solid infill on the model’s top surface and improves the top surface appearance. > > > > For more information, please check out release notes for 2.8.3 Public Beta and 2.8.4 Public Beta. ### Improvements #### New Collapse Status Icon on the Prepare Page Improved the visibility of the collapse feature: a new collapse status icon on the prepare page makes panel collapsing easier to discover, and clicking a panel title now collapses or expands that panel. Collapsing the device and filament panels while adjusting parameters gives you more room for parameter editing. #### Liveview on the Device Page Now Zooms Around the Cursor Position Previously, the Liveview image on the device page could only be zoomed around the center, so other areas could not be magnified. Zooming is now centered on the mouse position, making it easier to inspect. #### Parameter Differences Are Now Shown When Syncing Printer Information When opening a 3MF file or syncing printer information, the parameter differences between the current 3MF and the connected printer are now displayed, making it easier to decide what to sync. If no exact nozzle match is available, you can select one manually from the drop-down list. #### Added a TPU 75A Preset and Improved Support Printing Parameters and Behavior - Added a TPU 75A filament preset. - Optimized PVA retraction: instead of retracting 2 mm and then another 10 mm, PVA now retracts 12 mm in one continuous movement, so retraction is no longer interrupted and print quality is improved. - Optimized the printing temperature and cooling fan settings for Support for PLA/PETG, improving adhesion between this support material and PLA and reducing the risk of print failures caused by weak adhesion. #### Modifier Alternating Layers and Conformal Fill - Alternating layers: a modifier can now apply for N layers, then skip M layers, and repeat. Adding a wall every other layer, for example, creates a regular texture on surfaces such as shoe uppers. With "Ignore infill settings" enabled, the modifier overrides only the wall count and leaves the region's infill unchanged. - Conformal fill: sparse infill follows each layer's contour and runs radially on curved surfaces such as shoe uppers, while top and bottom shells, solid infill, and bridging keep their original pattern. Available on process, object, part, and modifier.
#### Tree Support Tip Diameter Can Now Be Adjusted The tree support tip diameter parameter is now available in Developer mode, giving more control over the size of support tips. For example, lowering this value produces finer supports when printing miniature models. #### AMS Filament Backup Improvements Previously, AMS filament backup could only work between spools of exactly the same filament and color. This update redesigns the AMS filament backup feature on the device page and relaxes some of these restrictions: you can now manually specify backup spools, so backup works between different subtypes (such as PLA Basic and PLA Silk) and different colors within the same filament family (such as PLA). Note: This feature is currently supported only on the Bambu Lab H3C printer. Support for other models will be added in a future firmware update. #### Other Improvements - Preserved per-face painting when performing Boolean operations, merging, or simplifying models, preventing paint loss ([#11444](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11444)). Thanks to [Cstm3DBldr](https://github.com/Cstm3DBldr). - Adding a diagonal wiping motion to the prime tower reduces the risk of printing failure caused by nozzle clogging and scraping. - Added an API to resolve the setting_id issue with locally saved user presets ([#12582](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12582)). Thanks to [chenshj73](https://github.com/chenshj73). - Remove the blocking prompt for mixed loading of high-temperature and low-temperature filament at the plate level, and permanently display the attention prompt and wiki link on the material synchronization page. - Locked the part position when selecting parts with Alt held down, preventing unexpected slight movements that change the relative positions between parts - Improved filament mapping and slot display when sending a print job. - Added detailed nozzle status to the device page and nozzle information to the filament page. - Improved the real-time display of extruder extrusion status on the device page. - Updated the auto-mapping rules for external AMS. - Added drying page support for external AMS. AMS drying can now be started when the printer is idle, with a prompt to connect the external power supply. - Moved the drying entry point to the drying page, consistent with the printer screen and Bambu Handy. - AMS now displays the temperature and humidity of slots that are not being dried. - Adjusted the layout of the project filament list: the sync and settings buttons are now on the same row as the flushing mode. - Added filament compatibility prompts for scenarios where X2D uses the filament selector. - Updated the image style of the new cool plate. - Improved parsing compatibility with standard 3MF files. - Added support for Bambu Lab E1 Purifier. ### Bug Fixes - Fixed a compilation issue ([#12596](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12596)). Thanks to [hadess](https://github.com/hadess). - Fixed the tooltip not closing on mouse hover on Linux ([#12262](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12262)). Thanks to [Alexey Cluster](https://github.com/ClusterM). - Fixed the software crashing due to the object list when opening certain projects. - Fixed multiple security issues and improved overall security. - Fixed a crash when copying or cloning objects ([#12232](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12232), [#12336](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12336), [#12375](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12375), [#12393](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12393)). - Fixed a crash that always occurred when importing an SVG image and attaching it to the model surface with "Use surface" selected. - Fixed the software freezing on macOS ([#12260](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12260)). - Fixed the software freezing permanently when hovering over parameter tooltips on Linux ([#12233](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12233), [#12253](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12253)). - Fixed an incorrect PETG support interface printing temperature (lower than the nozzle set temperature) ([#12509](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12509), [#12514](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12514)). - Fixed the brim disappearing after modifying the filament shrinkage compensation ([#12186](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12186)). - Fixed counterbore bridging not taking effect ([#12237](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12237)). - Fixed incorrect coloring on some layers when the model has extremely small fragmented faces ([#12720](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12720)). - Fixed the modifier not taking effect on certain models. - Fixed unexpected color overlay results when using the color mixing kit, where the closest target color could not be achieved. - Fixed the calibration page selecting filament/process presets based on extruder 1's nozzle diameter when X2D uses nozzles of different diameters ([#12227](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12227)). - Fixed the account being unexpectedly signed out after sending a print job ([#12451](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12451), [#12462](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12462), [#12492](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12492)). - Fixed the binding with the printer not being released after switching the connection mode. - Fixed the AMS icon not being fully displayed on the device page. - Fixed the external spool taking more than ten seconds to display correctly after switching printers or editing the external spool. - Fixed the window layout extending beyond the screen edge when the device page shows "Waiting for the heatbed to reach the target temperature" ([#12649](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12649)). - Fixed the spool 1 icon being obscured on the device page ([#12638](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12638)). - Fixed a white square appearing in the center of the screen and blocking the window after performing an action on macOS ([#12661](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12661)). - Fixed the inability to upload images when creating a project, which prevented the project from being saved ([#12665](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12665)). - Fixed the "Untrusted site" warning when opening models from MakerWorld. - Fixed the Model Mall and MakerLab pages not refreshing automatically after the network is restored following an offline start. - Fixed the clock not being able to switch to the 12-hour format ([#12223](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12223)). - Fixed incorrect translations of some parameters in Spanish ([#12667](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/issues/12667)). ## 中文 本次 Bambu Studio 版本更新适配拓竹 H 系列新品 Bambu Lab H3C 多头打印机，同时带来多项重要功能与体验优化，并修复了若干稳定性与安全问题。 您可以从 [Bambu Studio on Flathub](https://flathub.org/en/apps/com.bambulab.BambuStudio) 上下载适用于 Linux 的 Flathub 版本。 Flathub 版本由 [@hadess](https://github.com/hadess) 维护。感谢他为此付出的出色工作 ### 新功能 #### 支持混合口径喷嘴切片打印 这是本次 Bambu Studio 版本发布中最重要的更新。 多口径混合打印不是一个新话题，过去，用户可以按墙、填充、支撑等切片走线类型分配耗材和喷嘴，例如，在 “工艺-强度-高级” 页面设置稀疏填充、实心填充、墙的耗材。本次更新的不同点在于，Bambu Studio 将多口径混合打印推进到模型区域：在同一模型中，用户可以为局部细节和模型主体指定不同口径的喷嘴，**并让不同口径喷嘴采用各自合适的层高打印。** 这意味着，即使位于模型**相同的高度范围内，小口径喷嘴不必为了迁就主体而加厚层高，大口径喷嘴也不必为了局部细节始终使用薄层**。小喷嘴可以用较窄线宽、较薄层高还原文字和刻度；大喷嘴则以较宽线宽、较厚层高打印主体。细节留给需要细节的区域，效率留给适合快速打印的区域。 得益于这项能力，以使用 Bambu Lab H3C 打印的 Maker Watch (by DadaLand) 为例，精细表盘、表壳主体与柔性 TPU 表带可以在一次打印任务中完成，减少分件打印与后续组装的需求。[查看 Wiki](https://e.bambulab.com/t?c=Sqg2600TPZCRDDpU) 了解功能原理、适用场景及使用限制。 这项能力基于对切片架构的多处重构才得以实现，因此所有多头机型均会受益。混合口径涉及切片、材料、预设及AMS和喷嘴切换适配等多项工作，本次发布先适配 Bambu Lab H3C。其他机型的适配信息请以官方公告为准。感谢用户的耐心等待，同时欢迎用户和社区反馈实际模型中的切片与打印表现，或基于BambuStudio开源代码更新和迭代。 #### 混色功能更新与优化 - 操作更集中：拆色功能已并入混色页面改名为颜色匹配，添加混色耗材时可在同一页面完成手动混色与颜色匹配功能，该功能可以选择项目耗材中的目标色，自动计算出颜色匹配的混色结果，并支持用户在此基础上进行调整。 - 操作更便捷：对 Bambu Lab H3C 的 0.4 mm 喷嘴、0.2 mm 与 0.24 mm 层高预设，混色子层功能默认开启，无需手动设置。 - 耗材配置更灵活：混色耗材不再计入项目最多 32 种耗材的限额，并新增对拓竹混色耗材套件 **Bambu PLA Palette** 系列的支持。点击 “使用官方混色套装” 即可自动添加套件内的耗材。 - 重复配置更省事：手动添加混色耗材时会沿用上一次的混色参数，便于复制和微调。 - 纹理模型导入更顺畅：导入页面改为两阶段步骤式，流程更清晰；提升颜色量化性能；支持直接绑定拓竹混色耗材套件；优化界面与视觉布局。 > 另外前序[2.8.3 Public Beta](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/releases#release-v02.08.03.66)和[2.8.4 Public Beta](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/releases#release-v02.08.04.57)的功能也包含在此次版本更新中。 > > #### 优化顶面单调线填充图案的打印路径，减少空驶 > > 优化了顶面单调线填充图案的打印路径，减少打印过程中的空驶移动，从而提升打印效率。 > > 对于顶面细节越多、路径越复杂的模型，该优化效果越明显。 > > > > > > >
> > #### 切片参数 Tips 支持图文说明 > > 当用户将鼠标悬停在工艺参数名称上时，Bambu Studio 会显示对应的参数 Tips。现在，参数 Tips 支持图文并茂的展示方式，可以更直观地解释参数含义、作用及其对打印结果的影响，帮助新用户更轻松地理解和调整切片参数。 > > > > 注意：本次更新主要覆盖简单模式下的工艺参数。更多高级参数的 Tips 将在后续版本中持续补充和完善。 > > #### 支持单独设置首层墙与填充的线宽 > > 本版本新增了“首层填充线宽”参数。原有的“首层线宽”参数现在作用于除了首层填充走线之外的其他走线，包括首层墙。用户可以分别控制首层墙线宽与首层填充线宽。 > > 用户可根据实际打印效果，适当调大首层填充线宽。例如，使用 0.4 mm 喷嘴时，可将首层填充线宽设置为 0.55 mm，以改善首层附着效果，降低首层打印不佳的概率。 > > > > 注意：不建议将首层墙线宽设置得过大，否则可能增加部分模型首层细节丢失的风险。 > > #### 耗材管理器录入界面支持新增耗材供应商 / 品牌 > > 本版本优化了耗材管理器的耗材录入流程，支持在录入界面直接添加自定义耗材供应商或品牌。 > > > > 当对应的耗材参数预设不存在时，用户可以直接在耗材管理器中创建自定义耗材，无需再跳转到准备页面进行创建，操作流程更加便捷高效。 > > > > #### 熨烫类型新增阿基米德螺旋线图案，表面效果更均匀 > > 本版本为熨烫功能新增了阿基米德螺旋线图案。不同之处在于，用于熨烫的阿基米德螺旋线的打印顺序会以区域中心为起点逐步向外扩展，走线可被模型内部孔洞自然截断。相比普通同心图案，该打印方式可以减少最内圈走线产生的纹路，使熨烫效果更加均匀。 > > > > 注意：熨烫效果会受到流量、线距、顶面打印速度、温度、材料物理特性等多种因素影响。用户需要根据实际打印效果进行调校，默认参数并不保证适用于所有场景。 (详见 [Wiki](https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/software/bambu-studio/parameter/ironing)) > > #### 新增次顶面填充图案参数 > > 本版本将次顶面从内部实心填充中单独拆分出来，默认次顶面使用单调填充，以替代原先使用的直线图案。 > > > > 该调整有助于减少内部实心填充挤压纹在模型顶面透出的情况，提升顶面外观质量。 > > > > 更多请查看2.8.3 Public Beta和2.8.4 Public Beta的release note ### 优化与改进 #### 准备页面新增折叠状态图标 提升折叠功能的可见性：准备页面左侧面板新增折叠状态图标，让折叠功能更容易被发现。调整参数时，点击设备栏和耗材栏的标题可将它们收起，为参数编辑留出更大空间。 #### 设备页Liveview 画面支持以鼠标位置为中心进行缩放 此前，设备页 Liveview 画面只能以画面中心缩放，无法放大查看其他区域。现支持以鼠标位置为中心缩放，方便查看。 #### 同步打印机信息时显示参数差异 打开 3MF 文件或同步打印机信息时，会显示当前 3MF 与已连接打印机之间的参数差异，便于确认后再决定是否同步。若没有完全匹配的喷嘴，可从下拉菜单中手动选择。 #### 新增 TPU 75A 预设，优化支撑打印参数与行为 - 新增 TPU 75A 耗材预设。 - 优化 PVA 回抽动作：由原先的先回抽 2 mm后停顿、再回抽 10 mm，改为一次连续回抽 12 mm，回抽过程不再中断，改善打印质量。 - 优化 Support for PLA/PETG 材料的打印温度和冷却风扇参数，改善该支撑材料与 PLA 之间的粘接，降低因粘接不足导致打印失败的风险。 #### 修改器支持隔层生效，新增贴型填充模式 - 隔层起效果：修改器可按 “生效 N 层、跳过 M 层” 循环生效，例如隔一层加一圈墙，在鞋面等表面形成规律纹理；勾选 “忽略填充设置” 可只覆盖墙圈数、不改动原区域填充。 - 贴形填充：稀疏填充沿每层轮廓走线，在鞋面等曲面上呈放射状，顶底壳、实心填充与桥接保持原图案；工艺、物体、零件与修改器均可开启。
#### 支持调整树状支撑尖端直径 在开发者模式中开放树状支撑的尖端直径参数，可灵活控制支撑尖端的粗细；例如打印微缩模型时调小该值，可获得更精细的支撑。 #### AMS 续料功能改进 此前，AMS 续料只能在同一耗材、同一颜色的料盘之间进行。本次更新重新设计了设备页的 AMS 续料功能，并放宽了部分限制：现在可以手动指定续料耗材，同一耗材大类（如 PLA）下的不同子类型（如 PLA Basic 与 PLA Silk）、不同颜色之间均可续料。 注意：该功能目前仅 Bambu Lab H3C打印机支持，其他机型请等待后续固件更新。 #### 其他优化项 - 布尔运算、合并、简化模型时保留逐面涂色信息，避免涂色丢失（[#11444](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/11444)）。感谢[Cstm3DBldr](https://github.com/Cstm3DBldr) - 擦料塔增加斜向擦嘴动作，降低喷嘴粘料剐蹭导致的打印失败风险 - 新增接口，解决本地保存的用户预设的setting_id问题（[#12582](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12582)）。感谢[chenshj73](https://github.com/chenshj73) - 按住 Alt 选择零件时锁定零件位置，避免产生微小的移动导致多零件之间相对位置变化。 - 去除盘级别的高低温材料混打的阻塞提示，在材料同步页面常驻注意提示和wiki链接 - 优化发送打印时的耗材映射和槽位显示。 - 设备页显示喷嘴状态的具体问题，耗材页面展示喷嘴信息。 - 优化设备页挤出机的挤出状态显示实时性 - 更新外接 AMS 的自动映射规则。 - 适配外接 AMS 的烘干页面。打印机空闲时支持发起 AMS 烘干，并提示连接外接电源。 - 烘干入口调整为从烘干页面进入，与打印机屏幕和 Bambu Handy 保持一致。 - AMS 显示非烘干槽位的温湿度。 - 调整项目耗材列表的布局：同步和设置按钮移到冲刷模式所在的一行。 - X2D使用选料器的场景新增部分耗材兼容性提示。 - 更新新款冷打板（低温板）图片样式。 - 提升标准 3MF 文件的解析兼容性。 - 支持 Bambu Lab E1 空气净化器。 ### Bug 修复 - 修复编译问题（[#12596](https://github.com/bambulab/BambuStudio/pull/12596)）。感谢[hadess](https://github.com/hadess) -
